newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MIXED - GAS OIL DOWN AS FUTURES DIP.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MIXED - GAS OIL DOWN AS FUTURES DIP.

text.p: NWE oil products were largely softer on Thursday, traders said.
Gas oil lost nearly $3.00 a tonne amid quiet trade as IPE futures dropped in response to late Wednesday crude losses.
Gasoline barges lost $7 as the market partially corrected from recent massive gains, but the outlook was still seen bullish.
Naphtha did no more than move $1 lower on swaps as physical values were deemed unchanged at $195-$197 CIF NWE.
High sulphur fuel oil barges reversed earlier losses of about $1 to steady at $95/$95.50 fob ARA .
A major entered the market as a buyer late in the day. Low supply kept low and high sulphur cargo quotes notionally strong.
